pages.title: Identify Shards
pages.text: A weapon above Mortal tier leaves matching shards when fully broken. Blank shards have no weapon attributes.$(br2)Populated shards retain their source weapon information, part number, and restriction data. A Spiritual Weapon leaves one shard retaining at most 72 layers; excess layers are lost.

pages.title: Reforge the Complete Set
pages.text: Collect every distinct part from the same broken weapon and two stacks of spirit stones, 128 in total. Mixed weapons or duplicate part numbers do not form a complete set.$(br2)Put the complete set and stones in the Ding material slots. Reforging needs no extra recipe slip, but still requires suitable heat for the original weapon.

pages.title: Use Shards in Other Forging
pages.text: Instead of restoring the source weapon, valid shards can be extra materials in another forge. Their stored restrictions transfer automatically to the successful result.$(br2)A partial set cannot restore the original weapon, and reforging cannot recover layers already lost at shattering.
